verdict.rationale: A community user reports working around sporadic errors with retries (n8n-comm-18), and the docs describe error workflows for responding to execution failures (n8n-docs-5). Neither item documents a configurable per-step retry setting, and nothing mentions backoff. missing for 10: first-party documentation of per-node retry configuration, retry count and wait/backoff settings, exponential backoff support, independent hands-on corroboration.
